translations.text: Listen, all you peoples, and let the earth and all its inhabitants pay attention. Let the Lord God be a witness among you, the Lord from his holy temple.
A lying spirit arose and dripped wine and drunkenness upon you, and it will be from the dripping of this people.
I will make the broken one into a line of descendants and the crushed one into a mighty nation, and the Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion from now on forever.

The remnant of Jacob will be among the Gentiles, in the midst of many nations, like dew fallen from the Lord and like a drop upon the grass, so that it may not be gathered, and not one [?], and may not remain among the sons of men.
May your hand be raised over your oppressors, and may all your enemies be destroyed.
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy your horses from your midst and destroy your chariots.
I will wipe out your carved images and your pillars from your midst, and you will no longer bow down to the works of your hands.
In anger and wrath I will take vengeance among the nations because they did not listen.
Listen to what the Lord said: Rise and plead your case with the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
Your cities will come under siege and be plundered by the Assyrians, and your fortified cities will be divided into portions, from Tyre to the River, from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
